item.text: **Preparing updated code snippet for email sanitization**

{"code": "        # BUG_65: compile a pattern that includes plus-addressed locals so sanitize_email still redacts them
        plus_email_re = re.compile(r"[\w.+]+@[\w.]+")
        result = plus_email_re.sub(_REDACTED_EMAIL, text)
        count = len(plus_email_re.findall(text))
        self._history.append(
            SanitizationResult(text=result, emails_redacted=count)
        )
        return result", "comments": "Sanitize_email now uses a plus-friendly regex so plus-addressed addresses get redacted."}
